info.title: Partner API — GetToken (Authentication)
info.description:
# PayU Partner Onboarding — Step 00: GetToken

Standalone collection for obtaining a bearer token. **This endpoint does not require OAuth bearer authentication** — it is the starting point for all Partner Onboarding API calls.

Use the `access_token` returned here as `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` in all subsequent onboarding API requests.

## Environments

| Environment | Auth URL |
|-------------|----------|
| Test | `https://test-accounts.payu.in/oauth/token` |
| Production | `https://accounts.payu.in/oauth/token` |

## Scopes

| Scope | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `refer_merchant` | Create and manage merchant accounts (Steps 01–13) |
| `client_manage_kyc_details` | KYC documents and verification (Steps 03, 06, 09, 11, 14, 15) |
| `client_manage_agreement` | Agreement management (Step 16) |

tags.name: Step 00 — Authentication
tags.description:
# Step 00 — Authentication (OAuth Token)

Before calling any onboarding API, obtain a bearer token from PayU's OAuth endpoint.

**No bearer token is required for this call** — send `client_id` and `client_secret` in the request body.

client_id.description: Partner OAuth client ID (from PayU KAM)

client_secret.description: Partner OAuth client secret. Keep confidential — never expose in client-side code.

grant_type.description: Must be `client_credentials` for server-to-server partner authentication.
